d.title: Ushiro no Shoumen Kamui-san
d.jp: うしろの正面カムイさん
d.synopsis: Shizuka is a normal high school girl with the ability to see ghosts. Due to her peculiar tendency to attract ghosts, she works as an assistant to Kamui, a famous psychic. Kamui takes pride in his top-notch psychic abilities, but the way he exorcises ghosts is rather unusual!

rel.name: Ushiro no Shoumen Kamui-san Mini Anime Gekijou
